text:
Irene C: Quick proposal - run all short postmortem actions as a 2-week remediation runbook card so owners update status in one place.

Ben K: Agree, too many follow-ups vanish. What minimal fields do we need?

Irene C: Minimal: Owner (primary/backup), Priority, Start/Due, 2-line objective, Verification steps, Rollback window, Blocking deps, Recurrence tag.

Rosa M: Add a one-line comms snippet and blast-radius. Also require a monitoring query link for verification.

Ben K: For IC rotation, pair ICs for two weeks: week 1 primary, week 2 backup closes follow-ups. Post handoff checklist required.

Irene C: Cadence suggestion: D0 incident channel, D1 postmortem + create runbook card, Tue weekly 15-min sync for open 2-week cards, end of 2w review to close or escalate to roadmap.

ops-bot: Reminder created: 2w-remediation-sync Tue 10:00 starting 1825127000

Rosa M: Automation idea: when a postmortem contains "2w-remediation: yes" tag, auto-create card in board with template. Low friction.

Ben K: I'll prototype the automation (1 week). Irene can update playbook with the template.

Irene C: Actions: Ben - automation prototype due in 1w, Rosa - draft comms + verification snippet in 3d, Irene - add template to playbook in 4d.

Rosa M: +1 to timeline. Will post snippets in #eng-oncall.

Ben K: +1, will ping when prototype is live.

Irene C: If this works we'll run a 3-week pilot and review trends for recurrence tags. Closing thread for now.
